mission.title: Pirate Broadcast
mission.description: Investigate the restricted phone line system Mauser has been using.

npc.say: Do I get paid to talk to you? No. All right then.
No, I haven't seen anyone else using that phone. It's some kind of old dial-up data line or something, I think. We don't really use it now.
Uh... I think you might want the modeling agency on the other floor.
Yes, I think we may find Mauser there. This unusual signal could be part of what has enabled him to access the Matrix, in spite of having been grown outside the safety of the pod system.
The line has been severed. If the terrorists succeed in locating this place, they will be dealt with.
The line would have been run through the walls here... Yes... Right along here...

phase.briefing:
Although we conducted an operation that temporarily seized control of hardlines across the city, the individual known as Mauser has continued to traverse its confines. Much Zionite activity of late has centered around alternative phone lines; investigation has revealed that many of these lines were hacked or installed by terrorists some time ago, and had fallen into disuse. Mauser seems to have begun using them.
Archives we acquired from Zion's old mainframe have yielded fragmentary information on this line system. According to their records, the marked location contains, or contained, a telephone connected to the system.

enter.say: Whoa, I've got pirate signals in there. Someone's beat us to the phone.

done.say: The line seems to be active...but I can't navigate these protocols. Hm. Tracking Mauser on these things could be harder than I'd thought.

phase.briefing:
The information contained in the archives retrieved from Zion's old mainframe indicated that Zion reserved access to this line system for extraordinary use only. Although some data on the system's security measures was included in the captured archives, we do not currently have all the information necessary to access it. Zion appears to be having difficulty following Mauser through the system, so it is possible that the information they have is incomplete as well.
It is obvious that they possess information we do not, however, as their teams have been found investigating phone systems in multiple neighborhoods. Monitoring communications between these teams may yield useful information. You are to activate a snoop program on one of the Zionites.

enter.say:
Some of the phones they've been checking out have been in areas used by bluepills. If you can blend in and look like a bluepill just going about your business, you should be able to get close to one of the Zionites long enough for me to hook a Machine eavesdropping routine into their comm.
Just try not to run any obvious hack programs and you should do fine...as long as it isn't a Zionite you've run into before.

talk.say: How about you? Notice anyone messing with that phone lately? We just noticed some unusual activity on our records for this past billing cycle.

done.say:
Wow, you actually found a Zionite who didn't recognize us. I guess it's mostly the ones with white hair that we're running into all the time.
What? Oh, well...never mind. Anyway, I've got that snoop routine going.
Hey, don't mess with that while they're watching!

phase.briefing: The Zionites are very communicative... We have already monitored a transmission from another team who believes they are not far from Mauser's current position on the restricted line system. The indicated telephone must be secured and analyzed.

enter.say: Looks like Zion's been moving in on the line already. Better get in there.

done.say: Mm-kay. Readings look pretty similar to what we saw before... The Machines were gonna try some voodoo on it.

phase.briefing: Full simulation scans of the phone's vicinity revealed the recent presence of an unusual broadcast signal. Scans along projected connecting lines obtained a signal match. You may wish to join our personnel at the location now.

enter.say: Hm... I don't know for sure, but I think this means we rule.

talk.say: *Ciao, tesoro.* Your information was very useful. We did not find the interloper, Mauser, but we obtained a better reading of the unusual broadcast signal detected earlier. Exterior spectral analysis has found that the signal is originating from the vicinity of the destroyed Zionite city. Now it is merely a matter of narrowing down the signal to its source.

mission.finish: Isolation of the signal's broadcast point has already begun. An increase in storm activity north of our city, triggered by the Merovingian, is anticipated to complicate the procedure in some sectors. If you have not already done so, please ensure that you have loaded the updated meteorological profile into your ship's navigation system.
